question: What consequence follows if Arjuna refuses this righteous battle?
premises: fear of war would bring a hundred-branched fall upon you
if you do not fight this righteous battle
then abandoning duty and fame you will obtain sin
inference: Refusing the righteous battle brings sin after abandoning duty and fame.
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are analyzed as given rather than split
plain_english: The fear from which you would turn from war will itself fall upon you in a hundred branches. If you do not fight this righteous battle, then abandoning your own duty and fame you will obtain sin.
